notes: Upgrades Gradients into a full Gradient Studio: Linear, Radial, and Conic types; 16 direction presets plus exact 0-359 degree control; radial circle/ellipse shapes, four reach modes, 3x3 focal presets and exact X/Y center controls; conic rotation and center controls; repeating gradients; per-stop opacity; decimal stop positions; stop duplication; up to 12 colors; rotate/flip tools; live copyable CSS; and per-target reset. Removes the now-redundant separate Navigation gradient target so the unified Background remains continuous. Keeps GIF support, AO3-style required-tag icons, Split Screen, and all prior tools.
